approach: Add rename() method to TodoApp class that delegates to Todo.rename() following existing patterns for mark_done, mark_undone, and remove methods.
implementation_summary: Added rename(self, todo_id: int, text: str) -> Todo method to TodoApp class that loads todos, finds the matching todo by id, calls todo.rename(text) which handles validation (empty text check) and updates the updated_at timestamp, saves and returns the renamed todo. Raises ValueError if todo not found.
risks: None - minimal change following existing patterns in the codebase.
limitations: None - implementation matches all acceptance criteria from the issue.
